title.zh: 将杜马格特市普兰图比格小学更名为拉蒙·马格塞塞纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Pulantubig Elementary School at Dumaguete City to Ramon Magsaysay Memorial School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Pulantubig Elementary School at Dumaguete City to Ramon Magsaysay Memorial School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Pulantubig Elementary School at Dumaguete City thành Ramon Magsaysay Memorial School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Pulantubig Elementary School at Dumaguete City เป็น Ramon Magsaysay Memorial School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Pulantubig Elementary School at Dumaguete City menjadi Ramon Magsaysay Memorial School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Pulantubig Elementary School at Dumaguete City menjadi Ramon Magsaysay Memorial School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2555_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Pulantubig Elementary School at Dumaguete City is changed to Ramon Magsaysay Memorial School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
